verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say its payment capabilities let customers send and receive money by check, which touches both check issuance and check receipt. That is a single thin marketing mention. Nothing describes a check-issuance API, a check-deposit flow, or image capture. missing for 10: documented programmatic check issuance API, check deposit endpoint, front/back image capture for remote deposit, check status and lifecycle handling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, checks still work — programmatic check issuance and check deposit with image capture, because real businesses still receive and send paper

citations.quote: Send and receive money using payment capabilities including ACH, wires, real-time payments, checks, and international payments
